About Resize Pages

Make every page the same size — A4, US Letter, Legal, A5 or A3 — with content scaled to fit and centred. Useful before printing and for merged files whose pages don't match.

How it works

  1. 1Drop in the PDF.
  2. 2Choose the page size and orientation.
  3. 3Press Run and download.

Common questions

Does content get stretched?

No — it's scaled proportionally to fit and centred, so nothing is distorted.

Mixed portrait and landscape pages?

Choose “Match each page” to keep each page's orientation, or force one.

Can I trim instead of scale?

That's Crop PDF.
